evaluation.rationale: The opening shot of Juliana in pain immediately grabs attention, and the discovery of the ring adds intrigue. The ending leaves viewers wondering about the significance of the ring and Juliana's condition, but the scene is clear and emotionally impactful.
evaluation.hook_evidence: "Please, ring... you have to be here."
evaluation.cliffhanger_evidence: Macro close-up holding on Juliana's bloodied fist firmly gripping the emerald ring against the frozen ground as the episode cuts to black.
